Message:
ext4: remove unnecessary ext4_get_group_info in ext4_mb_load_buddy

ext4_mb_load_buddy() calls ext4_get_group_info() for setting both
"grp" and "e4b->bd_info", but it could do "e4b->bd_info = grp".
